```{r}
library(AICcmodavg)
m0 <- lm(PercentSurvival ~ 1, data = CellInhibition)
AICc(m0)
m1 <- lm(PercentSurvival ~ Inhibitor + Cell.Line + VHL + Concentration.uM, data = CellInhibition)
AICc(m1)
m2 <- lm(PercentSurvival ~ Inhibitor + Cell.Line + Concentration.uM, data = CellInhibition)
AICc(m2)
m3 <- lm(PercentSurvival ~ Inhibitor + VHL + Concentration.uM, data = CellInhibition)
AICc(m3)
m4 <- lm(PercentSurvival ~ Cell.Line + VHL + Concentration.uM, data = CellInhibition)
AICc(m4)
m5 <- lm(PercentSurvival ~ Inhibitor + Cell.Line + VHL, data = CellInhibition)
AICc(m5)
m6 <- lm(PercentSurvival ~ Inhibitor + Concentration.uM, data = CellInhibition)
AICc(m6)
m7 <- lm(PercentSurvival ~ Inhibitor + Cell.Line, data = CellInhibition)
AICc(m7)
m8 <- lm(PercentSurvival ~ Inhibitor + VHL, data = CellInhibition)
AICc(m8)
m9 <- lm(PercentSurvival ~ Cell.Line + Concentration.uM, data = CellInhibition)
AICc(m9)
m10 <-lm(PercentSurvival ~ VHL + Concentration.uM, data = CellInhibition)
AICc(m10)
#Delta AICc
AICc(m2)-AICc(m1) #m2
AICc(m3)-AICc(m1)#m3
AICc(m4)-AICc(m1)#m4
AICc(m5)-AICc(m1)#m5
AICc(m6)-AICc(m1)#m6
AICc(m7)-AICc(m1)#m7
AICc(m8)-AICc(m1)#m8
AICc(m9)-AICc(m1)#m9
AICc(m10)-AICc(m1)#m10
summary(m2)
summary(m3)
summary(m6)
candidate_models <- list (m1, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6, m7, m8, m9, m10)
model_names <- c("InhibitorCellLineVHLConcentration", "InhibitorCellLineConcentration", "InhibitorVHLConcentration", "CellLineVHLConcentration", "InhibitorCellLineVHL", "InhibitorConcentration", "InhibitorCellLine", "InhibitorVHL", "CellLineConcentration", "VHLConcentration")
aicc_table <- aictab(cand.set = candidate_models, modnames = model_names)
print(aicc_table)
```


```{r}
# I choose to start with the full model then move to all the 3-variable combinations. I then did tests for concentration and inhibitor without cell line or VHL and concentration or Inhibitor with Cell Line or VHL. 
#The full model m1 has the lowest AICc (3896.3) and highest weight (0.77) with m2 (Inhibitor + Cell.Line + Concentration.uM) having a delta_AICc of (< 4) and m3 (Inhibitor + VHL + Concentration.uM) & m6 (Inhibitor + Concentration.uM) having a delta_AICc of (< 10). All models share similar R-squared values of ~0.47-0.49. Inhibitor and Concentration have the lowest p-values (*** <<0.001), although VHL and Cell Line have p-values (* <0.05). A model that includes all four variables seems to be the best model.
 
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
